About the Bike Biloxi Monthly Ride group ride

Bike Biloxi Monthly Ride is a social group ride in Biloxi, MS. It rolls third Tuesday of the month at 6:00 pm from Biloxi Visitors Center.

A monthly social ride that meets at the Biloxi Visitors Center and is open to all. The regional trails group lists it as a dinner ride. Bring lights in the darker months.
